tweets.text:
Regarding kinetiq:native - in theory I think a discounted sale can work, but the two main issues in this case are;
- people feel misled, clearly there was a base assumption that it would be an airdrop, and whilst as a team you can say you never said that - introducing a points scheme in the exact same way that every airdrop works, on hyperliquid whilst claiming you are HL ethos aligned is going to lead to these assumptions and the team knows this, and saying ‘well we never said that’ is going to leave a bitter taste regardless and the team aren’t stupid enough to not know this
- a discounted sale can work, but it becomes a joke when the price point is higher than 95% of the days the token has been trade-able 

You can do a sale, but if you want it to be well received communicate it better ahead of time so people
Don’t feel misled (rightly or wrongly), and make it at an attractive price point that suitably rewards the users who have risked their capital earning you revenue
